scope: Independent static source review of the owned three-stage host only; no operation launched by this reviewer. Worker semantics are reviewed separately.

checks.no_import_command: Fixed stages are qualify, render and inspect only. Only render can launch Blender; qualify/inspect use fixed D Python -I -B scripts. GLB import stage/command is unreachable.
checks.review_binding: Exact commit/branch/helper pins, reviewed complete candidate Python source set and hashes, plan/test log/prior importer audit binding and installed importer source pins.
checks.predecessor_closure: Render requires fresh qualifying worker PASS plus owned qualifying host PASS with exact result hash; inspect similarly requires qualify/render. Previous direct output files and host receipts are watched.
checks.original_import_binding: Before render marker, exact original import-host SHA19c23db0a47c7e3c003013b70dab7b5fc67cc2e1ae8042fb2e621b45f1b6b370 must PASS and bind exact original worker receipt13ab7159c0db783ffd22404420c19d02d51b678ec5e87e18cf53565ba68ab3a7.
checks.render_headroom: Original measured import process and Job committed-memory peaks must each be <=5GiB before render admission.
checks.caps_and_floors: Unchanged6GiB process and aggregate Job caps;180-second execution bound; original pinned helper enforces12GiB available RAM and2GiB free disk before marker and live.
checks.ownership: Exact binary GO only after JobObject attachment; PASS needs owned tree naturally empty within180seconds, verified exit and no forced cleanup.
checks.exclusivity: Output folder, attempt marker and host receipt must all be absent; outputs use exclusive creation; no retry/overwrite.
checks.preservation: All watched source/prior-output sizes, modification times and byte hashes must remain unchanged; source watches come from authenticated closure.
checks.runtime: Private scratch and Blender user paths, CPU device environment, Blender background/factory-startup/disable-autoexec and4threads.
